authoring_notes: MANIFEST_GAP r20: the kitchen doorway is photographed (photos 2, 3) as an open black-lined opening with no leaf, hinge or track, and the brief requires it to stay open; it is built as a fixed frame, so no hinge body exists to test.
MANIFEST_GAP r6: the lone black cup in the middle of the counter was placed only for the recording; the creator asked for it to be left out.
MANIFEST_GAP r40: the motorcycle helmet on the bench was placed only for the recording; the creator asked for it to be left out.

MANIFEST_GAP r10: the desk telephone at the counter's wall end (photo 2 only) is not built - the creator froze the tea station and its movable props exactly as accepted, and that corner is the robot's working area.
MANIFEST_GAP r11: the round black lid / coaster beside the telephone (photo 2 only) is not built for the same reason as r10.

MANIFEST_GAP r34: the frosted-band glass door to the office shows no hinge, handle or swing in any photo; it stays the fixed panel the creator accepted, since the creator asked for the doors to be kept exactly as they are.
MANIFEST_GAP r49: copies 2 and 3 are the plain right and left boundary walls, which have no gate in any photo; the row's gate is on copy 1 (back wall) and is built as two working hinged leaves.
MANIFEST_GAP r7: the jar's screw lid is part of the jar's single free body; a threaded lid on a free body cannot be exported as its own joint.
MANIFEST_GAP r9: the kettle lid hinge is part of the lifted jug's single free body; a hinge nested on a free body cannot be exported as its own joint.
